answer: To combat Sybil attacks, the network employs Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, each agent must lock $2,500 in a smart contract. Second, peer nodes monitor all agent activities for consensus deviations. Third, any proven malicious behavior results in the immediate destruction of that escrowed capital. An attacker would need $250,000 in bonds and 45 days of constant verification to succeed. This mechanism serves as a heavy trellis for the digital garden, ensuring that no sudden surge of fake identities can crush the system like a massive, unstoppable glacier.
